icp.ideal_persona: Executive assistants or personal staff responsible for routine outreach
pain_points: Risk of missed or delayed communications
icp.primary_benefit: Automated, friendly email delivery that saves time and ensures consistency

milestone_1: Configure OAuth credentials, secure token storage, and verify Gmail API access
milestone_2: Deploy autonomous email sender and dispatch three generic friendly messages to anshtiwarif17@gmail.com

technical_blueprint.architecture: Serverless function (Google Cloud Functions) → Gmail API client → OAuth token store (Secret Manager) → Email template renderer
technical_blueprint.human_authorization_required: Initial OAuth consent screen and token grant for Gmail API; email address verification
technical_blueprint.autonomous_execution_scope: Compose email body from template and send via Gmail API without further human input

synthesis_summary: The project targets executive communication automation by integrating Gmail API with OAuth for secure, token‑based sending. A two‑milestone plan establishes credentials then autonomously dispatches three friendly messages, delivering time‑saving consistency. Pricing offers a pilot setup and a retainer for ongoing scaling and support.
